ideas.pitch: A Python and Streamlit-based web tool to rapidly repurpose and filter drug combinations for drug-resistant tuberculosis based on chemical property matching.
ideas.problem_statement: BB-PB-01 Repurposing shortlist for drug-resistant TB
ideas.title: TB-Shortlist Navigator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a specific therapeutic problem statement directly with a clean, working web demo that biomedical judges can test live.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight web app providing 3D protein structure visualization and binding-site inspection using browser-side rendering libraries.
ideas.problem_statement: BB-PB-02 Protein structure and binding-site explorer
ideas.title: PocketBind Explorer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers an interactive 3D visualization demo on the web, standing out against generic slides through real-time structural rendering.

ideas.pitch: A prototype hardware and cloud telemetry system monitoring temperature fluctuations for last-mile biologic and vaccine cold chains.
ideas.problem_statement: BB-PB-03 Last-mile cold chain integrity for biologics
ideas.title: ColdChain Guard IoT
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features an unusual physical build using real sensors and edge telemetry, ensuring it stands out in a room full of standard web applications.

ideas.pitch: A smartphone-based computer vision tool using fingernail bed color analysis to screen for non-invasive anaemia indicators.
ideas.title: AnemiaVision
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an urgent primary-care screening need with a camera-based pipeline that judges can test instantly on their own devices.

ideas.pitch: A mobile-friendly field-testing log and rapid optical analysis assistant for identifying water-borne pathogens from microscope images.
ideas.problem_statement: BB-DM-02 Field test for water-borne pathogens
ideas.title: PathoField Kit
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets an acute rural health challenge with a practical, field-ready mobile web interface that executes reliably during judging.
